changed_responsibilities: Midnight replaces Plume's opening upper-outer duty and supplies damage to Fang's first runner.
Ansel takes the first medical position and Hibiscus takes the upper reciprocal position.
Returning Fang and Vanilla replace dedicated intermediate outer blockers.
Returning Melantha and Midnight own western restraint destruction instead of Gallus and the parent's separate outer roster.

revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Reject the opening survival hypothesis and inspect Midnight's actual acquisition and first-runner damage. Do not credit later grants or retreat refunds from an unsupported survivor, and do not classify their absence as an arithmetic error.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: A ten-ID formation can preserve the parent's complete duty set through shared opening damage, reciprocal medicine and scheduled reuse of healthy returning operators; successful roadblock clearance alone never establishes central or artillery closure.

revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Reject the predicted early upper release. Inspect Midnight's actual target acquisition, skill execution and device damage before relying on protected-target survival; do not reinterpret later western clearance or a valid DP ledger as confirmation.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: Move Ansel to ordinary healing range of eastern Steward, establish both medics earlier, advance Midnight's first arts activation and retain him upstream. These changes are intended to preserve artillery damage and civilian survival while maintaining shared central damage and complete later clearance.

revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Inspect whether Ansel actually took damage and whether reciprocal recovery occurred through another packet sequence. revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: Separating medical splash exposure, overlapping lower interception upstream of the civilian and moving shared central arts earlier will preserve artillery damage and living containment long enough to finish both armored waves and safely release both protected targets.
